intro: Sleek, stylish, and effortlessly comfortable—the Tia chair fits every moment of your life. Its modern frame and ergonomic backrest keep you supported, for a quick breakfast or a long dinner with friends.

features.title: Sturdy chrome frame
features.text: A durable chrome-plated frame keeps the chair strong while adding a polished look.

features.title: Easy-care upholstery
features.text: Bonded synthetic leather makes it easy to clean and perfect for everyday use.

features.title: Comfortable backrest
features.text: Enjoy mealtimes without discomfort—the ergonomic backrest provides great support so you can sit back and relax.

features.title: Modern and versatile
features.text: Simple, stylish, and effortlessly versatile—this design fits seamlessly into your contemporary space.

features.title: Easy to clean and practical
features.text: We made cleaning easier for you—high ground clearance lets you sweep and mop effortlessly, keeping your dining area fresh.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
